# Mzansi Stream

> Mzansi Stream is a South African IPTV service with no contract and no decoder. The site lists live channels in 4K, including SuperSport, kykNET and SABC folders, plus movies and series; it publishes no channel count. A 24-hour trial needs no card. Orders and activation are on WhatsApp.

## Services

- IPTV subscriptions for South Africa and the SA diaspora. Order and support on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447307410512
- Website: https://iptvmzansi.com/en-za (default language: en; hreflang locales are listed below)

## Prices (ZAR)

- The homepage headline and the comparison table say from R99. Published plan totals are R199 (1 month), R449 (3 months), R699 (6 months) and R1199 (12 months). The pricing card also shows a rounded monthly figure (R100 on the 12 month plan).
- 24 hour free trial: free (R0)
- 1 month: R199 (1 month plan total)
- 3 months: R449 (3 month plan total)
- 6 months: R699 (6 month plan total)
- 12 months: R1199 (12 month plan total)

## Technical details

- Maximum picture quality: 4K/UHD (stated on the homepage and on every plan)
- Devices: Smart TV (Samsung, LG, Sony), Firestick / Fire TV, Android TV, iPhone, iPad, Android, Android TV Box, MAG Box, PC / Mac
- Activation: not stated on the site
- Bitrates / minimum bandwidth: 25 Mbps sustained per 4K stream, as written on the 4K IPTV South Africa page. The homepage does not print a bitrate.
- Channel count: not stated on the site

## Common questions (10)

### How much does Mzansi Stream cost?

Mzansi Stream publishes four one off plans in South African rand. One month is R199, three months is R449, six months is R699 and twelve months is R1199. The three month plan is marked most popular on the site. The headline also advertises plans from R99. A 24 hour trial is free with no card, and orders go through WhatsApp.

### How does the free 24 hour trial work?

You message Mzansi Stream on WhatsApp and ask for the free 24 hour trial. The homepage says no credit card and no commitment are required. Activation is done in the same WhatsApp thread, and the site publishes no fixed delay for it. You can try the service on a Smart TV, Firestick, phone or tablet before you pay.

### Is IPTV legal in South Africa?

The site's guide is not legal advice and makes no legality claim; it says redistributing copyrighted channels without permission is a copyright question. This site does not publish a licence schedule and does not state that Mzansi Stream holds broadcast or redistribution licences. The full written guide is the page Is IPTV legal in South Africa.

### Which devices does Mzansi Stream work on?

The homepage lists Smart TVs from Samsung, LG and Sony, plus Firestick and Fire TV, Android TV, iPhone, iPad, Android phones, an Android TV box, MAG Box, and PC or Mac. An M3U link is sent on WhatsApp for TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV or any standard M3U player. Install help is offered for the device you name.

### Can I watch SuperSport without a DStv decoder?

The homepage says SuperSport PSL, Premier League, Variety, Rugby and Cricket folders are on the lineup, alongside SABC and kykNET, and no DStv decoder is required. It does not promise every official feed or a buffer free picture. Rights and blackouts can still apply, so test the match you care about on the free 24 hour trial first.

### How fast is activation and is the programme guide included?

The homepage says activation is done on WhatsApp after the order and payment, with no fixed delay published. You receive an M3U playlist link and a short setup guide. The full electronic programme guide is included on every plan so you can see what is on now and what is coming up next.

### How do I pay and is there a contract?

Payment is handled on WhatsApp. The site lists EFT, SnapScan, Zapper, Yoco, Ozow, Capitec Pay, Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Bitcoin. The 24 hour trial does not need a credit card. There is no contract and no automatic renewal. You pay once and the service ends when the period you chose ends, then you renew manually if you want.

### Does Mzansi Stream work on SA fibre and outside South Africa?

The homepage says it runs over Vumatel, Openserve, Frogfoot, Octotel, MetroFibre, MTN and Vodacom fibre. A VPN is not required in South Africa. South Africans abroad use it too, but the site does not publish a country count. Outside South Africa it recommends a VPN, and the 24 hour trial is how you check your own connection.

### Can several people watch at once and what if a stream fails?

The standard plan includes one connection. If you need more than one screen at the same time, the site says to message WhatsApp for a tailored plan. The six month plan text mentions up to 3 devices. If a stream fails, you message WhatsApp; the site treats outages as a support job and publishes no fix time.

### Are Springboks rugby and Proteas cricket included?

Springboks Tests, the URC and the Currie Cup are the fixtures people ask for, via the SuperSport Rugby and Variety folders. The homepage adds that rights and blackouts can still apply, so it does not promise every fixture. Proteas matches and the IPL are listed via SuperSport Cricket and Star Sports. Check your fixture on the trial.

## Devices supported

Smart TVs: Samsung Tizen (2022+), LG webOS (2018+), Hisense VIDAA, Sony
Bravia (Google TV), TCL Google TV.
Streaming sticks/boxes: Amazon Firestick 4K, Nvidia Shield TV Pro,
Xiaomi Mi Box S, Apple TV 4K, Chromecast with Google TV.
Mobile: iPhone (iOS 14+), iPad, Android (Android 7+).
Dedicated IPTV: MAG Box 322/425A/524/540.

## Languages served

English (ZA, GB, AU, US, AE, NZ, ZW), Afrikaans, isiZulu, isiXhosa,
Portuguese (Moçambique), French. English variants are fully indexed;
non-English locales currently serve English copy and stay noindex on
programmatic pages until translation copy lands.

## Channel coverage

- Sport: SuperSport-style folders (PSL, Premier League, Variety, Rugby,
  Cricket). Matches and events are to confirm on WhatsApp; no
  every-match or PPV promise.
- SA channels: SABC 1/2/3/News, e.tv, eExtra, eMovies, kykNET, kykNET &
  Kie, kykNET Lekker, Mzansi Magic, Mzansi Wethu, Moja Love, M-Net.
- International: news and entertainment folders in addition to the SA
  list — line-up to confirm on WhatsApp. No premium-catalogue claim.

## Payment methods accepted

EFT (manual + Ozow instant), SnapScan, Zapper, Yoco, Capitec Pay, Visa,
Mastercard, PayPal, Bitcoin. No credit card required for the 24-hour
free trial.

## Compliance

Privacy questions go to WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447307410512.

IPTV is a delivery method. This file does not state that Mzansi Stream
holds broadcast or redistribution licences.

- Q: Can I watch SuperSport without DStv? — A: Yes, via Mzansi Stream
  IPTV — SuperSport-style folders, matches to confirm on WhatsApp.

- Q: How do I cancel DStv? — A: WhatsApp 060 060 3788, give 30 days'
  notice on Day 1 of your billing cycle — full guide at
